Registered Goal Discovery snapshot

Retained registered-lane view, not the current programme handoff. Two bets, one instrument that has to verify them, and 15 experiments. Every number here is read from a committed result package at render time — nothing on this page is typed by hand.

The two bets

C1
Coordination by a shared scarcity signal
Supported on one family

A divisible renewable commons. C1-002 showed it does not transfer to an indivisible good: a shared scalar is common-mode and can gate a population together but never stagger it.

C2
Symmetry breaking from a shared quantity
Sharper half, one family

Environmental heterogeneity substitutes for designer labelling — but the derivation rule and the period, which equals the population size, are both still authored.

Owned by wiki/conjectures.md, which admits a claim only with a stated refuter.

Can the instrument verify them yet? No.

The charter says the analytic arm is finished when four clauses hold on a specimen it was not built for. Until then no construction claim in this programme is verified — including both bets above.

  1. 1Recovery — proposes the authored coordinating structureMet on two families
  2. 2No false positive — abstains where the structure is absentNeither met nor failed: never validly tested
  3. 3Frozen before revealHeld where tested
  4. 4The proposal path was not authored against the caseUnsatisfiable as staffed — one agent writes both

The measurement this registered lane leaned on

Effective information, measured against each arm's own shuffle null. The claim under test is that it reports structure where coordination is present and nothing where it is absent. On one family it does. On the other it does not, and that is unresolved.

All 15 live experiments

Supported, one family 3 Narrowed 3 Negative result 5 Correction / voided gate 4

9 of 15 are negative results or corrections to earlier work. That is the honest shape of this registered evidence set, and it is a feature of the method rather than a failure of it.

  • Q1-010Correction / voided gate
    Does effective information above its own shuffle null separate coordination, or does it separate determinism?
    The suspicion that the headline statistic reads determinism rather than coordination was tested on the slot family and FAILED its own frozen gate: coordinated +6.3 null sd, deterministic-but-independent +1.65, independent draw ~0. That suspicion is not resolved on the commons, where an uncoordinated arm sits 5.3 null sd up and no experiment explains it; the clause holds on the slot family only.
  • Q1-009Negative result
    Does a coarse-grained description of these specimens carry causal structure the micro description does not, and does an independent goal-free measure agree?
    No causal emergence on either specimen: the coarse-grained description carries strictly LESS effective information than the micro one it was built from, in every non-degenerate arm. A later review found eight defects in this experiment's own code; every effective-information value survived, every empowerment value moved.
  • Q1-008Correction / voided gate
    Is the clause-2 floor caused by the substrate's congestion coupling?
    The statistic's floor is its own finite-sample null, about 0.12 at this horizon and entity count — not any property of the substrate. This experiment then committed the same below-null gate error it was written to catch.
  • Q1-007Correction / voided gate
    Does removing the substrate's congestion coupling let the relation statistic meet clause 2?
    The congestion explanation this experiment was built on is refuted: removing the coupling entirely RAISES the statistic instead of lowering it. Lane stopped.
  • Q1-006Correction / voided gate
    Can a statistic measure whether entity differences are related, rather than merely present?
    Coordinated scored 0.284 against matched-random 0.108. The clause-2 gate was frozen at 0.10 — BELOW the statistic's own finite-sample null — so no independent process could ever have passed it, and the recorded failure measured an unachievable gate.
  • Q1-005Narrowed
    Does the idiosyncratic fraction measure coordination, or only differentiation?
    The advantage over matched randomness is about 17% relative, not the total effect an earlier comparison implied: matched random reaches 0.375 against derived phase's 0.438. Most of the benefit is desynchronization, which randomness supplies free.
  • Q1-004Supported, one family
    Does the frozen detector, unchanged, separate a differentiated population from an active undifferentiated one on a family it was not built for?
    The instrument recovered an authored coordination on a second family it was not built for — a directional pass, carrying a caveat about the statistic it leans on.
  • C2-002Narrowed
    How load-bearing is the derivation rule that turns a subunit's own goal into a phase?
    The derivation rule matters only through how many distinct phases it preserves, which is one line of algebra about gcd(a, P) rather than an empirical discovery.
  • C2-001Supported, one family
    Can the distinguishing information that breaks symmetry come from the environment's own heterogeneity rather than from a designer assigning labels?
    Environmental heterogeneity can substitute for designer-assigned identity: satisfaction rises 0.000 to 0.438 as need spread widens, tracking distinct phases 1.0 to 6.6. Both the derivation rule and the period, which equals the population size, are still authored.
  • C1-002Negative result
    Does a shared-scalar coordination signal transfer from a divisible renewable resource to an indivisible contended slot?
    The same mechanism could not coordinate an indivisible slot at all. A shared scalar every subunit reads identically is common-mode by construction: it can gate a population together but never stagger it, so C1 is a price mechanism and needs a divisible good.
  • Q1-003Negative result
    Can a candidate family with a latent shared regressor separate a shared quantity that gates decisions from one that only constrains outcomes?
    A candidate family carrying a latent shared regressor closes the gap — but the record says plainly it does not qualify the instrument, because its author wrote it knowing the answer.
  • Q1-002Negative result
    Is Q1-001's null caused by the authored observation contract, or by the candidate family?
    The gap is not how the cases are packaged; it is what the model family can say. Repackaging changes nothing.
  • Q1-001Negative result
    Can the analytic instrument recover an authored coordination it was not told about, and not report it where it is absent?
    Handed a matched pair differing only in whether a coordinating signal was present, the instrument returned the SAME disposition for both. The candidate family has no way to express dependence on a shared quantity, so coordination is unrepresentable rather than merely undetected.
  • C1-001Supported, one family
    Does a shared scarcity signal have to track scarcity, or does the best fixed threshold coordinate as well?
    A shared scarcity signal beat the best fixed threshold on a renewable commons, 1.000 against 0.500 over 8 seeds — but the pre-registered control was weaker than claimed, and the effect size was revised down in the record.
  • P15Narrowed
    Can a modest type-directed proposal layer produce decision-relevant relational candidates or honest abstention across opaque archived systems without task labels?
    The freeze/reveal/audit machinery works end to end, but the capability it was meant to reward does not exist: applying all four proposers to all four cases gives an empty off-diagonal, so proposal generality measured zero.
